input_law: all 42 nonidentity reduced points, one supplied public point per independent search; neither selection nor stop reads its scalar
candidate_order: all 80 nonidentity coefficient-box pairs, ascending max(abs(a),abs(b)), then ascending a, then ascending b
online_interval: one rational aQ+bR point construction and reduction per prefix entry; Q,R, curve and input point are supplied; stop after target's scalar is derived and verified
collision_rule: first two distinct rational points with identical finite reduction and nonzero difference in b determine lambda=-delta_a/delta_b mod43
stop_rule: target is solved at its first b=0 lift, or after both its first lift and the first collision are present, whichever happens first
work: record exact rational point evaluations, reductions, dictionary lookups, prefix coordinate bit maximum, first collision index, first target hit and per-target stop; no wall-time comparison
claim_boundary: finite prefix operation-count diagnostic; a matched rho and calibrated complete pipeline are separate measurements
